item.title: NYC nursing walkout ends as last striking nurses approve new contract
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Nurses at a big New York hospital system approved a new contract Saturday, voting to end a major nursing strike after more than a month. item.title: Trump says he’ll raise tariffs to 15% after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he wants global tariffs of 15%, up from 10% he had announced a day earlier after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down many of the far-reaching taxes on imports that he had imposed over the last year.
